key_insight: WorldEvolver improves LLM agent planning by self-updating its deployment-time world model memory, without changing model parameters or the downstream agent.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical test-time way to make long-horizon agents more reliable by filtering bad foresight and turning experience into reusable memory.
method: Episodic Memory: retrieve real action transitions to simulate likely outcomes.
Semantic Memory: distill repeated prediction-observation mismatches into heuristic rules.
Selective Foresight: suppress low-confidence predictions before they enter agent context.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, WorldEvolver achieved the highest world-model prediction accuracy across three backbones and the best downstream agent success on AgentBoard compared with baselines.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality retrieval and confidence filtering, so noisy memories or miscalibrated uncertainty could weaken gains.
paper_title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
